The '''Battle of F'Dann IX''' took place some years before the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. The [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] fought the [[Crimson Nova]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] at [[F'Dann IX]]. In the battle, the [[Carrack-class light cruiser/Legends|''Carrack''-class light cruiser]] ''[[Dominant]]'', commanded by [[Pter Thanas]], was heavily damaged and recalled for repairs.<ref name="TTaBSb" />
